metadata.title: When you press every button except shoot and STILL get a kill in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Did not plan that kill... but hey, VALORANT said yes.
Watch me act like I meant it all along.
Only in VALORANT can chaos be a strategy.

Click if you’ve ever lucked your way out of a fail!

Tap if you’ve ever won by pure accident!

#valorant #funnyclips #gaming #luckygamer #shorts
